## Description

Settings → Doctors → Add doctor wizard: details (name, specialty, qualifications, languages) → licence (country, authority: state medical council/NMC or DoH/DHA/MOHAP, number, category, expiry, certificate upload) → verification (status pending/verified/rejected, verified_by, verified_at; done by Medvya operations or owner attestation per policy) → schedule (link to MDV-P1-011) → fees (default consultation fees; full services in P4) → access (role and facility scope) → signature (drawn or uploaded image; optional clinic stamp). Creates CLINICIAN_PROFILE and CLINICIAN_LICENCE and sends an invitation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A doctor cannot record or sign until licence status is Verified; the restriction is enforced server-side.
- [ ] **AC2.** Licence number format is validated per authority where a format is known; expiry date is required.
- [ ] **AC3.** The verification decision records who verified and when, and is audited; rejected licences notify the owner with the reason.
- [ ] **AC4.** The signature image is stored privately and appears only on printed prescriptions; the UI states "Signing in Medvya is always an authenticated action by the doctor (passkey / MFA), never the image alone."
- [ ] **AC5.** The new doctor appears in schedule columns once hours are set.

## Notes / open questions

- Define the licence verification process (who checks which register, SLA "usually within 1 working day") with the founder; this closes the P2 dependency.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
